method: One-off AI-assisted source retrieval and deterministic exact-string match on returned text; editorial critique, not an independent LLM or expert review. UN and Kroc reports. No automatic publication approval.

extraction.claim: The UN Secretary-General's spokesperson described five years remaining in the agreement's implementation timeframe.
extraction.quote: With five years remaining in the timeframe for implementation
extraction.uncertainty: The statement describes the timeframe, not the share of obligations completed.

critique.reason: Check actual implementation against separate monitoring data.

source.title: UN verification mandate renewed and refocused

extraction.claim: The UN mission says comprehensive rural reform verification was removed from its renewed mandate.
extraction.quote: the verification of comprehensive rural reform will no longer form part of the Mission's mandate
extraction.uncertainty: This does not mean rural reform obligations ended or were fulfilled.

critique.reason: Compare the renewed mandate with the original agreement and independently sourced rural reform data.

extraction.claim: The UN's weekly briefing reports that its Colombia representative highlighted reintegration of over 11,000 former combatants.
extraction.quote: the reintegration of more than 11,000 former combatants
extraction.uncertainty: This is a reported cumulative figure, not a rate of successful or safe long-term reintegration.

critique.reason: Check denominator, definition, reporting period and civilian protection indicators before making comparative claims.

extraction.claim: Kroc reported 30% of 578 stipulations fully implemented as of October 2021.
extraction.quote: 30 percent of the 578 provisions within the agreement have been completed
extraction.uncertainty: Rounded percentage of stipulations, not people protected or a measure of peace.

critique.reason: Compare with later Kroc assessments using the same denominator; check rounding and measurement definitions.

extraction.claim: Kroc reported 32% of the 578 commitments fully implemented in February 2024.
extraction.uncertainty: Reported percentages are rounded; category totals need not equal exactly 100%.

critique.reason: Do not infer continuous annual data or a linear trend between dated snapshots.

extraction.claim: Kroc's tenth report places full implementation at 36% by November 2025.
extraction.quote: 36 percent of the 2016 Final Accord’s 578 stipulations have reached full implementation
extraction.uncertainty: This is the latest of the three selected observations, not a November 2026 estimate.

critique.reason: Full implementation of provisions is not equivalent to civilian security. Gender and ethnic measures require separate examination.
